title: Interview with Farid
summary: Dana interviewed Farid, a chef, in a research interview.

qa_highlights.question: What role does the community play?
qa_highlights.answer: Volunteers found most of the bugs

qa_highlights.question: What was your biggest early mistake?
qa_highlights.answer: They trusted the vendor numbers without checking them

qa_highlights.question: How did people react when it came out?
qa_highlights.answer: Mostly curiosity, and some critics said the method was too slow

qa_highlights.question: How do you keep a balance?
qa_highlights.answer: Protects Sundays with no messages or screens and a long walk

quotes.speaker: Farid
quotes.text: Without them we would still be guessing.

quotes.speaker: Farid
quotes.text: No messages, no screens, just a long walk.
